content.text:
I have everything I need. The current `Populator` mixes three concerns: field initialization strategy, per-species probabilities baked as constants, and view color registration as a constructor side-effect. Here's the design:

**`FieldPopulator`** — interface with a single `populate` method. `SimulationController.reset` parameter type changes to this.

**`EntityFactory`** — `@FunctionalInterface` for `(Field, Location) → Entity`, enabling lambda expressions in the config.

**`SpeciesEntry`** — immutable value object bundling `(Class speciesClass, Color displayColor, double creationProbability, EntityFactory factory)` per species. Keeps all species configuration in one place. Holding the display color here is correct: it's a property of how a species is configured, not of the view itself — the color data travels with the species, but registration on the view stays the caller's job.

**`RandomFieldPopulator`** — implements `FieldPopulator`; constructor takes `List<SpeciesEntry>`. Has a `static createDefault()` factory for the standard 8-species setup. The `populate` loop iterates species in order and draws a fresh RNG roll per entry — identical call order to the original `else-if` cascade. Exposes `getSpecies()` so `Simulator.reset()` can iterate entries to register colors without re-coupling the populator to the view.

**`Simulator.reset()`** — calls `createDefault()`, registers colors by iterating the species list, then passes the populator to the controller.

The existing `Populator.java` becomes dead code (no remaining callers); it stays on disk but is no longer used.

---
name: project-r002-module-java
description: "R002 module_java safari sim — class hierarchy, 8 strategy/delegation refactors, non-deterministic (no golden hash)"
metadata:
  type: project
---

R002 module_java (safari sim with weather, disease, time). Hierarchy: Entity → Organism → Animal → Predator/Prey/Scavenger; Organism → Plant. Species: Lion/Cheetah/Elephant (Predator), Goat/Zebra (Prey), Vulture (Scavenger), Grass/PoisonBerry (Plant). Swing GUI; NON-deterministic (has no seeded Randomizer reset, uses Math.random for some sex gates) — no golden-hash harness. Plain javac, default package.

Environmental systems: Weather (WeatherType enum: RAIN/SUN/SNOW/THUNDER), TimeOfDay (SUNRISE/DAY/SUNSET/NIGHT). All RNG through `Randomizer.getRandom()` singleton (seeded, but not re-seeded on reset → different from R006/R009).

Refactors completed (8 total, all clean-compile verified):
- #1 DiseaseProfile interface — extracted getDiseaseSpreadProbability/getDeathByDiseaseProbability into interface; Animal implements it; Animal.handleDiseaseDeath()/spreadOrFindFood() helpers collapse act()-level disease blocks across 6 species. DiseaseProfile methods must be `public` (interface rule).
- #2 BreedingProfile + ReproductiveStrategy — BreedingProfile interface (getBreedingProbability, getMaxLitterSize, getBreedingAge); Organism implements it; breed() RNG computation extracted into static ReproductiveStrategy.computeBirths(BreedingProfile, boolean); breed() removed from Organism; giveBirth() delegates to ReproductiveStrategy.
- #3 GridNavigator — adjacency logic (adjacentLocations, getFreeAdjacentLocations, randomAdjacentLocation) extracted from Field into GridNavigator helper; getFreeAdjacentLocations takes Predicate<Location> to avoid back-reference to Field; Field delegates.
- #4 WeatherEffect strategy — WeatherEffect interface with getBreedingProbability(Weather); GrassWeatherEffect/PoisonBerryWeatherEffect impls; Plant gains setWeatherEffect/applyWeatherEffect; Grass/PoisonBerry replace 5-line conditional with applyWeatherEffect(weather) call.
- #5 SimulationController — all step/environmental logic (advance(), reset(FieldPopulator)) extracted from Simulator; Simulator is a thin orchestrator (view + controller + monitor). Named constants STEPS_PER_HOUR=5, HOURS_PER_DAY=24, etc.
- #6 PopulationStatsMonitor — statistics collection from SimulatorView extracted into PopulationStatsMonitor; wraps FieldStats; isViable() moved off the view; SimulatorView gets updatePopulation(String) for display-only role.
- #7 GridRenderer — FieldView nested class + colors map extracted from SimulatorView into top-level GridRenderer extends JPanel; SimulatorView reduced to label/layout; setColor() delegates to renderer.
- #8 FieldPopulator interface + RandomFieldPopulator — Populator replaced by: FieldPopulator interface (populate(List<Entity>, Field)); EntityFactory @FunctionalInterface (create(Field, Location)); SpeciesEntry value object (speciesClass, displayColor, creationProbability, factory); RandomFieldPopulator implements FieldPopulator, createDefault() builds 8-species config, getSpecies() allows Simulator.reset() to register colors without coupling populator to view. SimulationController.reset() now takes FieldPopulator. Old Populator.java still on disk (dead code — no callers).

Key invariant: the else-if cascade semantics (one species per cell, independent rand.nextDouble() per species check) preserved exactly in RandomFieldPopulator.populate() via for-loop with break.

Substantive structural work now exhausted. Old Populator.java is dead code but harmless. Related: [[project-r009-module-java]] [[project_r006_module_java]].

Refactor #8 is done. Here's what changed:

**New files:**
- `FieldPopulator.java` — strategy interface: `void populate(List<Entity>, Field)`
- `EntityFactory.java` — `@FunctionalInterface`: `Entity create(Field, Location)`, enabling lambda factories
- `SpeciesEntry.java` — immutable value object bundling `(speciesClass, displayColor, creationProbability, factory)` per species
- `RandomFieldPopulator.java` — implements `FieldPopulator`; constructor takes `List<SpeciesEntry>`; `createDefault()` builds the 8-species config; `populate()` replicates the original `else-if` cascade exactly (sequential `rand.nextDouble()` draws per species, breaks on first match); `getSpecies()` lets callers register colors without re-coupling the populator to the view

**Updated files:**
- `SimulationController.java:85` — `reset(Populator)` → `reset(FieldPopulator)`
- `Simulator.java:100-107` — `reset()` now calls `RandomFieldPopulator.createDefault()`, iterates `populator.getSpecies()` to register display colors on the view, then passes the populator to the controller. The old view-coupling side-effect of the `Populator` constructor is gone.

`Populator.java` is now dead code but harmless on disk. All 8 refactors are complete; further structural extraction on this codebase is exhausted.
